==Usage==
This is an infobox for technical and usage information on space station classes. Note that the Location information parameters should not be filled in for any space station shown to be mobile.

Cut and paste the following code into your article, then put the relevant specifications after the "=" signs.
<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>{{Top}}
{{SpaceStationClass
